title: Connecting Captions — Live On-Device Captions for Mac
excerpt: On-device live captions on a Mac. Voice stays on the machine. No cloud required unless you turn it on.
content_html:
local-host.ai Connecting Captions For work Chris Swim Lee

Live captions on a Mac. Each sentence appears when it is ready. Use it for a presentation, a bilingual room, or any conversation that needs a translation.

Completely on-device by default. Speech recognition and Apple Translation run on this Mac. Voice never leaves the machine unless someone turns on a cloud speech model. Theater doesn’t call home. No account. No telemetry.

Arabic · Chinese · Danish · Dutch · English · Finnish · French · German · Hebrew · Hindi · Indonesian · Italian · Japanese · Korean · Malay · Norwegian · Polish · Portuguese · Russian · Spanish · Swedish · Thai · Turkish · Ukrainian · Vietnamese

Who it’s for

  • Presentations. Theater sits over the slides. A whole-screen share includes it. Share the slides window when the room should not see the captions.
  • Bilingual rooms. Speak any of the 25 languages. The other side sees a caption or a translation.
  • Any conversation. Put the Mac in the room. Each sentence appears when it is ready. Voice stays on the machine.

Install

macOS 15 or later. Theater streaming needs Apple Silicon. The zip is notarized.

  1. Unzip Connecting-Captions.zip and drag Connecting Captions to Applications.
  2. Open Theater, allow the microphone, then press Listen.

Homebrew

brew tap chrisswimlee/connectingcaptions brew trust chrisswimlee/connectingcaptions brew install --cask connectingcaptions

What it is

  • A Theater window over slides. A whole-screen Zoom or Meet share includes it. Share the slides window when viewers should not see the captions.
  • On-device Apple Translation. Speech recognition comes from FluidVoice.
  • Voice stays on this Mac. A cloud speech model is something you turn on.
  • No account, no telemetry, no captions uploaded. Works offline once models are on disk.

What you need

  • macOS 15 or later. Theater streaming needs Apple Silicon.
  • Microphone for Listen. Accessibility only if you type into another app.

For work

Personal use stays free. A named license is $60 per Mac per year, five Macs minimum. IT can see the prices without emailing for a quote.

  • How does this monetize? Named license $60 per Mac per year, five Macs minimum. Written SLA +$90 per Mac per year. MDM pkg $1,500 once. Transcripts, voiceprints, and training data are not part of the sale.
  • Does voice leave this Mac? No, by default. Speech and translation run on the device. Voice stays on the Mac unless someone turns on a cloud speech model. Theater doesn’t send anything home. No account, no telemetry.
  • Who fixes a break? Security reports get a reply within 7 days. A paid license can add a written SLA.

A project from local-host.ai by Chris Swim Lee

为谁而设

  • 演示文稿。 剧院位于幻灯片之上。 全屏共享包含它。 当房间内不应看到字幕时共享幻灯片窗口。
  • 双语室。 会说 25 种语言中的任意一种。 另一方看到标题或翻译。
  • 任何谈话。 把Mac放在房间里。 每个句子在准备好后就会出现。 声音保留在机器上。

安装

macOS 15 或更高版本。 影院流媒体需要 Apple Silicon。 邮政编码经过公证。

  1. 解压缩 Connecting-Captions.zip 并将 Connecting Captions 拖至应用程序。
  2. 打开剧院，允许使用麦克风，然后按“收听”。

它是什么

  • 幻灯片上方的剧院窗口。 全屏 Zoom 或 Meet 共享包含它。 当观看者不应看到字幕时共享幻灯片窗口。
  • 设备上的 Apple 翻译。 语音识别来自 FluidVoice。
  • 语音保留在这台 Mac 上。 云语音模型是您可以打开的东西。
  • 没有帐户，没有遥测，没有上传字幕。 模型存入磁盘后即可离线工作。

你需要什么

  • macOS 15 或更高版本。 影院流媒体需要 Apple Silicon。
  • 用于收听的麦克风。 仅当您在另一个应用程序中输入内容时才可访问。

为了工作

个人使用免费。 指定许可证的价格为每台 Mac 每年 60 美元，至少五台 Mac。 IT 人员无需通过电子邮件获取报价即可查看价格。

  • 这如何盈利？ 命名许可证每台 Mac 每年 60 美元，至少五台 Mac。 书面 SLA + 每台 Mac 每年 90 美元。 MDM 每包 1,500 美元一次。 文字记录、声纹和训练数据不属于销售范围。
  • Does voice leave this Mac? 否，默认情况下。 语音和翻译在设备上运行。 除非有人打开云语音模型，否则语音会保留在 Mac 上。 Theater doesn’t send anything home. 没有帐户，没有遥测。
  • Who fixes a break? Security reports get a reply within 7 days. A paid license can add a written SLA.
